comments:
e13590e9:  ;This routine is for DGJ patch 3 post-installation.
 ;It manages environment checks, pre-installation, and post-installation routines.
eed3ae0b:  ;Start of the environment check routine.
1a31b8f3: ;Initialize the abort flag to an empty string.
32c48eaa: ;Check for necessary variables: user, DUZ(0) set to @, DT, and U set to '^'.
89d39fb1: ;Display a series of asterisks for emphasis.
c78c7503: ;Inform the user that their programming variables are not correctly set up.
8340ba10: ;Inform the user that the installation process has been aborted.
b9ccb90a: ;Notify the user that the environment check is complete and successful.
1ce6974d: ;Exit point for the routine.

a09cd1e0:  ;Abort block starts here.
 ;This block is executed if the environment check fails.
39b31e2b: ;Set the abort flag to 2 and quit, indicating an error state.

db702cbf:  ;Pre-installation routine starts here.
 ;It includes necessary cleanup or setup tasks before the actual installation.
166f1d2f: ;Set DIK for deletion, DA for the sub-entry, and DA(1) for the main entry in the 'DGJ' file.
9802bf67: ;Execute the deletion command.
abff6835: ;Exit point for the pre-installation routine.

603c4c4a:  ;Post-installation routine starts here.
 ;It includes tasks to be executed after the installation.
7ec34810: ;Initialize variables for the DIC call.
1aa33882: ;Set DIC for the 'Option' file lookup and DIC(0) for exact match.
f4c11c51: ;Define the option to be put 'out of order'.
af44f466: ;Attempt to find the option in the 'Option' file.
d7137055: ;Display a series of asterisks for emphasis.
3214408b: ;Display message about disabling the option.
53a08ba3: ;Set the out-of-order message.
e8834ab6: ;Execute the command to disable the option.
8af8f1b8: ;Exit point for the post-installation routine.
